setup_calls: attacker deposits 1 wei to mint one initial share
attacker transfers 500 ether directly to the vault

attack_steps: Attacker becomes the first depositor with 1 wei, receiving the only share.
Attacker donates 500 MTK directly to the vault, inflating totalAssets without minting shares.
Victim deposits 1000 MTK and receives only one share due to integer truncation.
Attacker redeems the initial share for an outsized portion of the vault assets.
preconditions: The token supports direct transfers to the vault.
The attacker can front-run or initialize the vault before the victim deposit.
hypotheses.rationale: SyntheticVault.deposit calculates new shares from the live token balance. A first depositor can donate assets without increasing totalShares, forcing later deposits to mint too few shares and letting the attacker redeem more tokens than they started with.

setup_calls: attacker deposits 1 wei to mint one initial share
attacker transfers 500 ether directly to the vault

attack_steps: Attacker initializes MultiBugVault with a 1 wei deposit.
Attacker donates 500 MTK directly to the vault so the live balance no longer matches share supply.
Victim deposits 1000 MTK and receives only one share because minted shares are computed against the donated balance.
Attacker withdraws the original share and receives a disproportionate payout.
preconditions: The token supports direct transfers to the vault.
The attacker can initialize the vault before a victim deposit.
hypotheses.rationale: MultiBugVault.deposit pulls tokens and then computes minted shares from token.balanceOf(address(this)). Direct donations inflate the denominator without increasing totalShares, so later depositors are under-minted and the first depositor can withdraw victim value.

attack_steps: Victim and attacker deposit into MultiBugVault, creating 1100 MTK of pooled principal.
The owner sets yieldPerSharePpb, but no separate yield reserve is deposited or accounted for.
Attacker initializes lastClaim, advances time by one second, and calls claimYield again.
claimYield transfers 1000 MTK from the shared vault balance to the attacker while the attacker retains their shares.
preconditions: The vault owner has configured a positive yieldPerSharePpb.
The vault holds other users' principal when claimYield is called.
hypotheses.rationale: MultiBugVault.claimYield computes owed yield from shares and elapsed time but pays it directly from the vault's pooled token balance without tracking yield reserves or burning shares. A shareholder can receive unbacked yield funded by other depositors' principal while their shares remain outstanding.
